== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Aurra Sing (V) (AI) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-aurrasingai-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-02-Aurra_Sing.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Once during opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to a site where opponent has a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1250_2ai</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
